global_options.description:

In strict inittab, these are per-line. This template applies them globally for demonstration, but a production template would likely move these into the `ttys` list or handle them differently. However, to adhere to the constraint of parametrizing site-specific values based on the man page, we will actually move global-like options into the per-tty object or keep them simple.
